name: @w6w-apps/mollie
description: Accept payments, manage refunds, customers, mandates and subscriptions on Mollie, the European payment gateway.

w6w.longDescription:
Mollie is a European payment gateway: accept payments over 30+ methods (iDEAL, cards, Bancontact, SEPA Direct Debit, PayPal, Klarna, and more) via Payments, hosted Payment Links, and recurring subscriptions billed against a saved Mandate, then track, refund and reconcile them.

This app covers that core payment-gateway surface — Payments, Refunds, Chargebacks, Methods, Payment Links, Customers, Mandates and Subscriptions — the path a workflow needs to accept a payment and later reconcile, refund, or bill a recurring charge against it. Monetary amounts are always `{currency, value}` objects with `value` an exact decimal STRING (`"10.00"`), never an integer of cents.

Mollie's Orders API (and its companion Shipments API) is deprecated by Mollie itself as of this writing — the vendor's own docs mark every `orders-api` operation `deprecated: true` and steer integrations at the Payments API's `lines` field instead — so this app does not implement it.

The wider Mollie Connect surface (OAuth-based platform/marketplace access on behalf of other Mollie merchants — Organizations, Clients, Client Links, Balance Transfers, Onboarding, Capabilities, Permissions) and Business operations (Balances, Settlements, Invoices, Payouts, Sales Invoices, Business Accounts, Terminals, Wallets, Delayed Routing, Unmatched Credit Transfers, Sessions/Checkout Sessions) are a different activation and a different account relationship, and are left out rather than half-covered.
